name: create-world
description: Create a new CloudWorld world: instruction set, Blender models, library.json, registration, and verification.

steps.prompt:
Build the 3D models for world {{worldId}} with the Blender MCP, following skill steps 5 and 6 and the entries in worlds/{{worldId}}/resources.md (the user has reviewed them).

Previous step summary:
{{steps.design.output}}

Build structure and family entries first, then key services. Save reusable scripts in worlds/{{worldId}}/blender/. Look at each model from two angles and compare with the style source. Export optimized GLBs to public/worlds/{{worldId}}/models/ and set each finished entry to built. Run `npm run validate:worlds`. If Blender is unavailable or a tool needs approval you lack, call send_message with severity warning and ask the user. Finish with send_message severity success and the list of built and missing models.

Integrate world {{worldId}} into the app, following skill steps 7 to 9.

Previous step summary:
{{steps.models.output}}

Write public/worlds/{{worldId}}/library.json from world.md and resources.md, register the world ({{worldName}}) in the world list, then build the app and capture screenshots of the sample plan in this world (scripts/capture.mjs or Playwright MCP). Compare with the style source, fix obvious problems, and save public/worlds/{{worldId}}/preview.webp from the real scene. Finish with send_message severity success and the screenshot paths.

Verify world {{worldId}} without changing design decisions. Follow skill step 10.

Previous step summary:
{{steps.integrate.output}}

Run `npm run validate` and `npm run test:e2e`. Confirm that switching to this world does not change the graph, selection, or findings. Fix test or validation failures that your work caused. Do not commit or push. Report the checklist at the end of the skill with pass or fail for each item, then finish with send_message severity success (or error if anything still fails).
